_comment: Workflows whose RED IS THEIR OUTPUT, not their failure. A detector reports a
condition; while the condition holds it exits non-zero, and that is the
design. scripts/watch-silently-dead-crons.mjs lists these separately instead
of calling them dead — without this it would report them every day forever,
and a watch that cries wolf is how odds-backfill.yml went fifteen days
AN ENTRY HERE IS NOT AN EXCUSE. Each names the condition it reports and the
document tracking it. The watch still prints how long each has been red, so
a detector red for months stays visible rather than becoming furniture.
Adding an entry to silence a genuinely broken workflow is the abuse this
file makes easy to spot in review: the reason has to be written down.
